Hold a public hearing on Ordinance 2026-29 to adopt and enact a moratorium on all development applications (i.e. plats, construction plans, building permits etc.) for commercial and residential developments in an area generally bounded by the eastern right-of-way line of I-35W to the east, a line approximately 2,900 feet north of FM 407, the western right-of-way line of US Hwy 377 to the west, and a line approximately 5,300 feet south of FM 407. The area includes properties on both the north and south sides of FM 407 between I-35W and US Hwy 377 and includes all land indicated as commercial and residential designation on the Town of Argyle Future Land Use Plan dated June 2024 and zoned as commercial or residential on the latest Zoning Map; providing findings of fact; providing exemptions; providing a waiver procedure; providing for a termination date; providing for severability, and providing an effective date.
